## Key Architectural & Lifestyle Highlights
- **Grand Arrival Experience**: Pune's 1st 4,000 Sq. Ft. Double-Height Italian Marble Grand Lobby with 24/7 Concierge.
- **Rooftop Sky Club**: 30th-floor 5-Star Rooftop Aqua Theatre, Infinity Horizon Pool, and Skyline Cocktail Sundeck.
- **Master Suites**: Dedicated Designer Walk-In Dressing Closets in every residential floor plan.
- **Architectural Scale**: 30 Storeys Iconic High-Rise Elevation across 3 Luxury Towers on a 3.38-Acre Gated Sanctuary.
